plot: One early morning Crispy's corner is empty and his soot prints stop inside the freezer; Bup and Zeek lead a search through ice trays and a pea avalanche while Zeek's Ember-o-Meter keeps beeping at a small black ice cube he calls broken, until tired Pim sits on the cube and finds it warm: it is Crispy, who froze his embers to hide from the glowing garden flames that hunt anything bright, the bros disguise themselves as snowballs until Pim's sneeze ruins it, and something warm starts knocking on the freezer roof.

script.title: Where Did Crispy Go? The Freezer Knows

beats.say: Crispy's corner is EMPTY! Everybody, into the freezer, now!
Soot footprints. They go into the freezer... and then they just stop.
So where did Crispy go? Rocks don't just vanish!
M-m-maybe he moved out? Maybe he found a warmer family?
Crispy never leaves without a goodbye. Well. He barely says hello.
Fear not! My brand new Ember-o-Meter finds anything warm. Behold!
It's beeping at... an ice cube. A small, black ice cube.
That ice cube is giving me a look. I hate it.
Nonsense. Ice cubes don't look. My meter just needs new batteries.
Okay team, here's the plan. Split up. Search every single shelf!
Lolly checks the ice tray. Zeek checks fish sticks. Pim hides.
Frostbite, did you take him? Oh, wait. He's at my tea party.
Then who took him? Crispy! Give us a sign! A spark! Anything!
A frozen bag of peas bursts. Ten thousand peas roll everywhere.
They're everywhere! They're freezing! One is inside my bandage!
Stay calm! Peas are harmless! Mostly! Slip-resistant feet, everyone!
If Crispy's gone, who warns us when the Thing comes down?
Ember-o-Meter, again! Find the warmest thing in this whole freezer!
The same ice cube?! Again?! This machine is officially broken.
It's still looking at me. I think it just blinked.
Maybe the Thing on the Roof took him. It watched us.
Then we go up there. To the roof. Tonight.
N-n-nope! Not the roof! Anything but the roof! I'll take the peas!
Through the freezer window, the hundred garden flames have crept closer.
The flames are moving toward the house. We need Crispy right NOW!
Hold the door, Pim! Don't let any light out of here!
Holding it! Holding it! Why is the door handle so cold?!
Every shelf. Every drawer. Every pea. He's simply not here.
I need to sit down. My legs are two frozen beans.
Pim plops down right on top of the small black ice cube.
Huh. Why is this ice cube... warm?
Because it's me. Get off.
The ice cube TALKS! I'm fainting! I'm fainting right now!
Crispy! We searched the whole freezer! You were right there!
I was hiding. From you. From everything.
So my Ember-o-Meter was right. Twice. I'm keeping it.
But why the freezer, Crispy? You hate the cold.
Those flames in the garden are eyes. They hunt anything that glows.
My embers glow. So I froze them. Now nothing can see me.
That's actually smart. Okay team, new plan. Everybody gets frosty!
The Dough Bros roll in frost. Now they are five lumpy snowballs.
Wait, did I faint? Why am I a snowball? Ah... ah... ACHOO!
Pim's sneeze blasts the frost off everyone. Crispy's embers glow bright again.
Pim! You un-snowballed the one rock that needed to hide!
...Thanks, Pim. Really.
Wait. Something warm is right above us. On the freezer roof.
Knock. Knock. Knock.
